source.title: UCSD Facilities Information System - Israni BRF - Fourth Floor - Master Plan

knownUnmapped.reason: Current schedule key; the normal public first-floor viewer returned an error. No room polygon or floor outline was recovered.

scaleCalibration.method: Intersect all 89 non-target polygon-area squared-scale intervals implied by whole-square-foot rounding, then choose the interval midpoint. 4103 is a held-out check; all 125 pairs are audited with a 0.01 sq ft coordinate-quantization margin.

limitations: Public raster requests returned Login HTML. Native polygons are the geometry evidence; no raster details or drawing revision are claimed.
Only level L4 has recovered geometry. Event-organizer sources explicitly place 1104 on L1 and 5A03 on L5; these levels have empty outlines and unplaced listings only. 1102 remains knownUnmapped.
Floor outlines are the published space polygon parts, not a surveyed exterior slab. Unassigned polygons remain explicitly unknown areas.
Local meter scale is derived from published rounded room areas, not measured dimensions. Campus geo, true north and alignment to other floor plans are unverified and omitted.
The floor elevation and story height are display estimates.
The clear architect third-level drawing and low-resolution Senate fifth-level thumbnail cannot establish the missing current target rooms.
Public corridor ID 87238, (C)4107, has a self-intersecting boundary and is omitted from the runtime outline/areas and scale calibration; its unchanged original coordinates remain in the review.

87238.label: (C)4107
87238.reason: The published corridor ring self-intersects/self-touches at nonconsecutive repeated vertices. It is excluded from runtime and scale calibration rather than repaired without independent wall evidence.
